<answer>
**1. Conventions that deviate from stack defaults**

- README is a single heading (`# dbms`), zero content; all documentation lives in `qa/EVIDENCE.md`.
- `wrangler.jsonc` instead of the more common `wrangler.toml`; `dev` script runs port 8788 (wrangler default is 8787); `compatibility_date` is 2026-08-01 (recent); D1 `database_id` is an all-zeros placeholder with a comment (remote deploy requires real id).
- Static assets served from `./web` via the `assets` binding (default is `./public`); frontend is vanilla JS with a hash router, no build step, no framework.
- Tests use `better-sqlite3` as a D1 emulator (`test/d1.ts`) instead of `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers` or miniflare; vitest config uses `environment: "node"`.
- `tsconfig.json` types only `@cloudflare/workers-types`, has no `jsx`, and `include` covers only `src` (tests/web/qa are outside typecheck).
- Multi-file migrations with explicit numeric prefixes (`0001_init.sql`, `0002_seed.sql`) - conventional for D1.
- `node_modules/` is installed (pnpm) despite gitignore - .omo task artifacts exist but repo itself is pnpm-based.
- Package name `dbms-family`, private, ESM (`"type": "module"`), `engines.node >=18` (default for Workers is >=20 now; deliberate for Node 24 compat noted in auth.ts).

**2. Anti-pattern markers (grep evidence)**

- No DO NOT / NEVER / ALWAYS / DEPRECATED / TODO / FIXME / HACK / XXX comments anywhere in src/, migrations/, web/, test/.
- The `ALWAYS`-adjacent hits are normal prose: `app.ts:223` "Users may self-join a tree, but always as VIEWER", `graph.ts` "defaults to younger" documented choice, and migration comments about ISO-string dob ordering.
- `app.ts:538-540` uses `as never` casts to force D1 results into `KinshipGraph`; `test/d1.ts:32` uses `as never[]` for better-sqlite3 run args - deliberate type-unsafe seams.
- `src/server/app.ts:48,52,69` - `bad(c: any, ...)`, `currentUser(c: any)`, `requireAccess(c: any, ...)` - untyped Hono context (deviation from the typed `AppEnv`).
- No `.only`/`.skip` in tests; no `@ts-ignore`/`eslint-disable`; `console.log` only in qa scripts, not src/.
- `as any`/`: any` appears in test code (`test/api.test.ts` 6 hits) but not in src/.
- Documented "forbidden" patterns in comments are runtime safety notes, not lints: `graph.ts` "UNION alone still grows lvls unbounded" (cycle cap), `0001_init.sql` "dob/dod are ISO-8601 date strings so lexicographic compare == chronological compare".
- `qa/CLEANUP.md` documents that live wrangler dev sessions were killed and state dirs removed - evidence of cleanup discipline, not an anti-pattern.

**3. Hotspots (files >500 lines)**

- `/home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/src/server/app.ts` - 545 lines. Largest source file; single Hono app with all routes + inline SQL + `requireAccess`/`currentUser` helpers. Complexity concentrated in the recursive-CTE generations route (~60 lines) and the 16-column person insert.
- `/home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/test/api.test.ts` - 455 lines. Largest test file; ~15 `it` blocks spanning auth/RBAC/CRUD/kinship/photo/membership.
- `/home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/web/app.js` - 374 lines. Monolithic SPA: router, auth screens, tree board, wires SVG, small box, big modal all in one file.
- `/home/srijan/Documents/projects/dbms/src/kinship/terms.ts` - 169 lines but extremely dense (4 langs x 33 keys); `migrations/0002_seed.sql` - 218 lines of mostly kin_term INSERTs.
- No file exceeds 600 lines; app.ts is the only one over the 500-line threshold.

**4. Public exports/symbols other files import**

- `src/index.ts` is the sole entry: `export { app }` (named) + `export default app` (both styles used).
- `src/kinship/index.ts` is the barrel: `classify`, `resolveTerms`, `TERMS`, `KIN_TERM_ROWS`, plus re-exported types `KinshipGraph, KinshipPerson, KinshipCouple, KinshipChildOf, ClassifyResult, EdgeKind, TermRow`. Internal files `graph.ts` (buildAdjacency/genderOf/olderThan) and `types.ts` are imported only within the kinship module.
- `src/server/auth.ts` exports: `hashPassword, verifyPassword, makeSessionToken, readSessionToken, sessionCookieValue, sessionSetCookie, publicUser, DEV_SESSION_SECRET, PublicUser`.
- `src/storage/b2.ts` exports: `uploadPhoto, setB2Fetch, B2ConfigError, B2Env` - the `setB2Fetch` injectable is a test seam used by `test/b2.test.ts`.
- `src/server/app.ts` exports: `app` (default), `Bindings`, `AppEnv`, `RowUser` (internal, not exported - defined but unused outside).
- Cross-module surface: `app.ts` imports from kinship barrel, kinship/terms, storage/b2, and auth; tests import from `../src/index`, `../src/kinship/index`, `../src/storage/b2`, and `./d1` (the D1Shim class + `migratedDb`).
- Public API routes (not TS symbols, but the real surface): `POST /api/signup|login|logout`, `GET /api/me`, `GET|POST /api/trees`, `DELETE /api/trees/:id`, `POST /api/trees/:id/members|access`, `POST /api/trees/:id/persons`, `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/persons/:pid`, `POST /api/persons/:pid/photo`, `POST /api/trees/:id/couples`, `POST /api/couples/:cid/children`, `GET /api/trees/:id/generations`, `GET /api/kinship?tree=&from=&to=`.
